deltas.description: Add requirement: The system SHALL print `Goodbye, <name>!` for `farewell <name>`.

scenarios.name: Named farewell
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** the user runs `farewell Ada`
- **THEN** the output is `Goodbye, Ada!`

scenarios.name: Named farewell
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** the user runs `farewell Ada`
- **THEN** the output is `Goodbye, Ada!`

deltas.description: Add requirement: The system SHALL print the greeting in upper case when `--shout` is given.

requirement.name: Shout
requirement.text: The system SHALL print the greeting in upper case when `--shout` is given.

scenarios.name: Shouted greeting
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** the user runs `greet Ada --shout`
- **THEN** the output is `HELLO, ADA!`

deltas.description: Modify requirement: The system SHALL greet the user by the name given on the command line, trimming surrounding whitespace.

requirement.name: Greet by name
requirement.text: The system SHALL greet the user by the name given on the command line, trimming surrounding whitespace.

scenarios.name: Named greeting
scenarios.rawText:
- **WHEN** the user runs `greet " Ada "`
- **THEN** the output is `Hello, Ada!`
